digest.component_or_area: operation-scoped configuration and provider-auth composition framework
propositions: Rebar must resolve one immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot at each operation boundary with consistent precedence: explicit input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, preventing mid-operation reread of ambient state

Authentication composition across LLM, Git, bridge, MCP, review-bot, observability, and op-cert must follow a single application-wide contract without making Rebar a credential store, using provider-native auth injection only through RP-01's existing ProviderSession path
Static credentials must be represented as provider-specific Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes carriers revealed only in sending adapters, never stored in global os.environ or universal secret brokers

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before queue/worker/network creation, and use a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file copy isolated from runtime SSM/boto3 coupling

Trusted same-capability children inherit ambient environment for compatibility while unrelated sibling children must remove exact secret names declared by other Rebar adapters, with deployment boundaries as primary isolation

A portable local-and-CI AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject direct/aliased config reads and backend reloads below approved seams, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover
